text.arabic_uthmani: وَوُضِعَ ٱلْكِتَٰبُ فَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُشْفِقِينَ مِمَّا فِيهِ وَيَقُولُونَ يَٰوَيْلَتَنَا مَالِ هَٰذَا ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةًۭ وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّآ أَحْصَىٰهَا ۚ وَوَجَدُوا۟ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ حَاضِرًۭا ۗ وَلَا يَظْلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًۭا

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the record-placement scene as continuation of the prior judgment address
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes the eschatological tableau and moves directly from the prior judgment address into the placement of the record. The book scene therefore feels like the next procedural event in the same summons, not a detached statement.

topics.headline: resumptive launch of the record scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the book scene continues the prior Day tableau rather than beginning as an isolated doctrine.
topics.reason: QAC and discourse evidence identify the particle as a resumptive scene opener that links the prior display before the Lord to documentary exposure.

words.gloss_range: passive perfect placing of the record, foregrounding the set-down object while delaying the named agent
words.root_gloss_range: root range of placing, setting down, laying out, and composing; local passive selects concrete placement while broader birth/composition pressure remains image-level
words.prose: {{ar:وُضِعَ}} ({{tr:wuḍiʿa}}) sets the book into the scene in the passive, so the record itself takes procedural prominence while the placer is withheld until the final Lord-subject. The qiraat contrast makes the case work visible: the canonical wording casts the book as nominative passive subject, while the active reading would cast the same book as accusative object set down by an agent. The placement root makes accountability feel physically staged without replacing the canonical passive.

topics.headline: passive placement with delayed agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the record becoming a concrete placed object before the Lord is named explicitly at the close.
topics.reason: The canonical passive and nominative book are locally decisive; variant active wording usefully exposes the voice-case contrast but does not control the canonical parse.

words.gloss_range: the definite placed record of deeds, syntactically prominent as the passive subject and semantically binding scattered deeds into evidence
words.root_gloss_range: root range of writing, prescribing, recording, and binding/joining; local noun selects the written record with binding evidentiary pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبُ}} ({{tr:al-kitābu}}) is not introduced as an unknown item; it is the definite record set down as the passive subject and evidentiary center of the scene. Its writing-and-binding root lets scattered deeds become one inscribed object, and the ayah will return to the same book inside the criminals’ own question.

topics.headline: definite record as evidentiary object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the book as the axial evidentiary object that triggers fear, speech, enumeration, and the justice claim.
topics.reason: Definiteness, nominative passive-subject role, repetition later in the ayah, and record-counting parallels support the record as the ayah’s documentary pivot.

words.gloss_range: consecutive particle marking the seeing as immediate consequence of the book’s placement
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns placement into immediate perception. Once the record is set down, the ayah moves straight into seeing the exposed criminals, so the book’s force is shown through its instant effect.

topics.headline: immediate link from placement to seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices no gap between the record being placed and the scene becoming visible to the addressed observer.
topics.reason: The particle functions as taʿqīb, linking the passive placement to the following perception clause.

words.gloss_range: second-person imperfect seeing that makes the addressee an observing witness inside the judgment scene
words.root_gloss_range: root range of seeing, perceiving, and judging/considering; local form selects visual witnessing with evaluative scene pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَى}} ({{tr:tarā}}) shifts the scene into addressed, unfolding perception. The addressee sees the criminals fearful before hearing their lament, and the parallel fear scene (42:22) helps mark this as public exposure tied to consequence. Within the surah’s visual judgment motifs, the displayed earth and displayed persons now become displayed records.

topics.headline: addressed vivid seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices being pulled into the scene as a witness before the criminals speak for themselves.
topics.reason: The imperfect and second-person form create vivid witnessing; contextual parallels with 42:22 support the fear-before-consequence frame.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative active-participle label for the criminals as the seen object, morally classifying them before their lament
words.root_gloss_range: root range of cutting, committing offense, and acquiring culpability; local participle selects criminals while cutting/severance remains moral image-pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimīna}}) makes the group the object seen and classifies them before they speak. The root’s cutting-to-culpability pressure makes their crime feel like severance from right order, while the parallel with 42:22 sharpens the legal register of this fear scene.

topics.headline: criminals exposed before speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their moral status is named before sympathy can be drawn by their cry.
topics.reason: The accusative object role and definite participial label support exposed moral classification; root imagery is kept as pressure, not as a separate local action.

words.gloss_range: accusative Form IV active participle describing the criminals’ bound state of apprehensive dread during exposure
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes apprehension, tender fear, and twilight/redness; local participle selects dread while chromatic and compassion associations color the state
words.prose: {{ar:مُشْفِقِينَ}} ({{tr:mushfiqīna}}) supplies the criminals’ circumstantial state at the moment of seeing. The Form IV participle makes dread a condition they have entered, and the root’s apprehension, tender-fear, and twilight coloring give that fear a visual-emotional hue within a scene governed by sight; the 42:22 parallel keeps the dread tied to earned consequence.

topics.headline: dread state with marked emotional color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fear is not incidental emotion but the visible state attached to the criminals as they are exposed.
topics.reason: The accusative participle functions as a ḥāl for the criminals; broader twilight and compassion associations survive only as image-pressure around the locally selected fear sense.

words.gloss_range: compound preposition marking what is in the book as the source or cause of the criminals’ dread
words.prose: {{ar:مِمَّا}} ({{tr:mimmā}}) compresses source and relative content: their dread arises from what the record contains. The phrase can attach tightly to the fear or more broadly to the exposure, but either way the book’s contents become the pressure point.

topics.headline: contents as source of fear
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their fear comes from the book’s contents, not from the book as a mere symbol.
topics.reason: The fused min-plus-relative form supplies causal/partitive force after the fear participle.

words.gloss_range: locative phrase with attached pronoun, presenting the book as containing incriminating material
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) keeps the book active as the referent and makes it a container of evidence. The fear is directed toward what is inside the record, so written contents become the cause of visible dread.

topics.headline: record interiority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the record has an inside that exerts pressure on the criminals.
topics.reason: The locative preposition and pronoun refer back to the book and support an interior-content reading.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking visible fear with the criminals’ spoken lament
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the seeing-and-fear clause with the saying clause without restating the subject. The lament therefore does not float free; it emerges as the verbal outburst of the same exposed group whose dread has just been shown.

topics.headline: sight joined to speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their speech is the audible continuation of the exposure already seen.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the prior perception/fear sequence with the following plural speech verb.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural saying that opens the quoted lament and makes the criminals’ recognition audible
words.root_gloss_range: root range of saying, speaking, and declaring; local imperfect introduces direct speech as unfolding confession
words.prose: {{ar:يَقُولُونَ}} ({{tr:yaqūlūna}}) opens direct speech in the same vivid present texture as the seeing verb. Their words move from lament into recognition of exhaustive record, making speech function as self-incriminating confession; the same-surah regret echo with 18:42 intensifies the shift from worldly loss to judgment loss.

topics.headline: direct speech as self-incriminating confession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the criminals themselves articulate the record’s reach rather than having it reported only by the narrator.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural speech verb introduces quoted material and is tied by person/number to the same accountable group that later finds its deeds present.

words.gloss_range: vocative particle governing an abstract noun of woe, converting recognition into direct outcry
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) makes the first sound of the quotation an exclamation. By governing an abstract woe noun, it dramatizes desperation as a summons to destruction rather than a request for information.

topics.headline: vocative turns analysis into outcry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quoted speech begins by summoning ruin itself rather than calmly explaining the book.
topics.reason: The vocative particle introduces the abstract lament noun and marks an exclamatory speech act.

words.gloss_range: possessed noun of woe or ruin, intensified by its form and made collective by the first-person plural suffix
words.root_gloss_range: root range of woe, ruin, and destruction; local possessed noun selects the criminals’ collective cry of doom
words.prose: {{ar:وَيْلَتَنَا}} ({{tr:waylatanā}}) turns woe into something possessed by the speakers: their ruin, not abstract sorrow. The -t- shape before the first-person plural suffix makes the lament compact and corporate, while the shared self-condemning lament formula in 5:31 frames recognition after irreversible wrongdoing.

topics.headline: collective self-woe
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the criminals claiming ruin as their own collective outcome.
topics.reason: The possessed lament noun and plural suffix support collective self-condemnation; the 5:31 formula is a concrete echo, not a replacement for the local cry.

words.gloss_range: fused interrogative-plus-preposition asking what is with this book; not the wealth noun, though same-surah sound echoes remain meaningful
words.root_gloss_range: assigned root range relates to wealth/property in other contexts; local form is the interrogative-prepositional compound, with wealth only as an audible contrast
words.prose: {{ar:مَالِ}} ({{tr:māli}}) is locally the fused question “what is with,” not the wealth noun. That limit matters because the sound still recalls the surah’s earlier wealth scenes (18:34; 18:39; 18:46), turning property confidence into bewilderment before the record.

topics.headline: bewildered question with displaced wealth echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a panic question about the book, with the surah’s earlier wealth language audibly displaced into judgment bewilderment.
topics.reason: Local grammar selects mā plus li; same-surah wealth rows survive as sound and thematic pressure, not as the selected lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: proximal demonstrative that makes the book present, visible, and confronted inside the criminals’ speech
words.root_gloss_range: demonstrative assignment has no active lexical root pressure beyond pointing and proximity in this local use
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَا}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) brings the record into the criminals’ immediate field: this book, here before them. The deictic force foregrounds the book inside their panic before they describe its exhaustive action, joining same-surah recognition moments where pointing marks realization after events (18:62; 18:78).

topics.headline: proximal pointing at the record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the record being pointed at as a present object that cannot be distanced.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is proximal and modifies the known record in the quoted question.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive reprise of the same record, now inside the criminals’ question rather than the narrator’s placement clause
words.root_gloss_range: root range of writing, prescribing, recording, and binding/joining; local reprise renews the written-record pressure inside quoted speech
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكِتَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-kitābi}}) is the same definite record as the opening book, but its case and role have changed inside the quotation. The shift from placed subject to questioned genitive bridges narrated evidence and subjective recognition.

topics.headline: same book reprised in panic speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same book moving from objective placement to the criminals’ own object of panic.
topics.reason: Definiteness, referent continuity, and case shift from nominative to genitive show the same record reprised in direct speech.

words.gloss_range: negation particle beginning the no-omission frame that will be completed by the exception particle and counting verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) opens the quoted no-omission construction. Together with the later exception particle, it turns “does not leave” into an affirmative claim that everything has been counted.

topics.headline: negation opening totality frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar starts by eliminating omission before converting that denial into total enumeration.
topics.reason: The negation scopes over the following verb and participates in a lā...illā restriction construction.

words.gloss_range: Form III imperfect with the book as subject, denying omission of any small or great item
words.root_gloss_range: root range of leaving, omitting, and betrayal; local verb selects non-omission while betrayal pressure makes omission feel like a breach of justice
words.prose: {{ar:يُغَادِرُ}} ({{tr:yughādiru}}) gives the book active procedural force: it does not leave anything behind. The root’s leaving-and-betrayal range is narrowed locally to non-omission, while the rare same-surah pair with 18:47 moves totality from no person left ungathered to no deed left unrecorded.

topics.headline: book leaves nothing behind
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the record acting with total thoroughness, leaving no deed outside its field.
topics.reason: The local subject is the book and the construction is negated non-omission; betrayal remains semantic pressure rather than an independent local event.

words.gloss_range: indefinite feminine singular adjective used substantively for any small matter within the merism
words.root_gloss_range: root range of smallness, littleness, and low scale; local form maps smallness onto recordable moral detail
words.prose: {{ar:صَغِيرَةًۭ}} ({{tr:ṣaghīratan}}) turns smallness into a countable object of the record. As one pole of the small-great merism, it makes exhaustive accountability concrete down to the detail, with documentary parallels in 2:282 and 9:121.

topics.headline: small item as recordable unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even what seems small becomes a discrete accountable item.
topics.reason: The adjective is substantivized as an accusative object and paired with the great-item pole to express total range.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle binding the small and great poles inside one negated totality frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the small item to the large item within the same no-omission frame. The conjunction keeps the pair working as one totalizing range rather than two separate complaints.

topics.headline: connector inside the merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two scale poles being held inside one exhaustive construction.
topics.reason: The particle coordinates the two substantivized adjective poles within the negated construction.

words.gloss_range: second negation particle explicitly denying omission at the large-item pole as well as the small-item pole
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) repeats the negation before the large item, so the second pole is not merely implied. Both ends of the scale are explicitly closed before the exception clause converts the denial into counted totality.

topics.headline: repeated negation closes the scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that both ends of the scale receive their own negated slot.
topics.reason: The duplicated negation reinforces the small-great merism under the same no-omission construction.

words.gloss_range: indefinite feminine singular adjective used substantively for any great or grave matter, completing the small-great range
words.root_gloss_range: root range of greatness, largeness, magnitude, and gravity; local form maps greatness onto accountable moral weight
words.prose: {{ar:كَبِيرَةً}} ({{tr:kabīratan}}) completes the other pole of the merism. Its mirrored form and separately negated slot make the scale complete, so the following enumeration claim covers the whole range rather than a loose example pair.

topics.headline: great item completing the range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that obvious grave matters and tiny details fall under the same record.
topics.reason: The second accusative object pole mirrors the small item morphologically and structurally, completing the exhaustive scale.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the negation-exception construction and forcing the positive result that every item has been counted
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}) completes the restrictive construction. After the small-great range, the exception particle turns non-omission into positive enumeration: nothing is left unless it has already been counted.

topics.headline: exception converting denial into enumeration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar permits no middle state between omitted and counted.
topics.reason: The particle follows a negated verb and introduces the perfect counting clause, creating exceptive totality.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect counting verb with feminine pronoun gathering the small-great merism into a counted object
words.root_gloss_range: root range of counting, reckoning, and pebble-like granular enumeration; local Form IV selects completed exhaustive tallying
words.prose: {{ar:أَحْصَىٰهَا}} ({{tr:aḥṣāhā}}) closes the quoted complaint with completed enumeration. The attached pronoun gathers the small-great pair into the counted target, and the counting root’s pebble-like concreteness makes the reckoning feel granular rather than abstract; parallels such as 58:6 and 78:29 place the book inside a divine enumeration network.

topics.headline: completed granular enumeration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the record’s totality is not vague memory but completed, itemized reckoning.
topics.reason: The perfect Form IV and feminine object pronoun support completed exhaustive tallying; concrete pebble-counting imagery is narrowed to lexical pressure.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction moving out of the quoted lament into narrated discovery
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes narration after the quoted totality claim. The movement is from spoken recognition to experiential confirmation: the deeds themselves are found present.

topics.headline: return from speech to discovery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah shifting from what the criminals say to what they then confront.
topics.reason: The conjunction marks a new narrative stage after direct speech and before the plural finding verb.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural finding verb whose complement frame makes past deeds encountered as present reality
words.root_gloss_range: root range of finding, encountering, existence, and emotional discovery; local verb selects finding/encounter while existence pressure makes the deeds real before them
words.prose: {{ar:وَجَدُوا۟}} ({{tr:wajadū}}) turns the book’s accounting into encounter. The criminals find what they had done as present reality; the root’s existence pressure is narrowed to the fact that their deeds are not merely listed but proven there, while the broader emotional range of finding is felt only as confrontation. The realized-truth parallel in 7:44 strengthens that verification pattern.

topics.headline: finding as confronted reality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from recorded enumeration to direct confrontation with the deeds themselves.
topics.reason: The verb is transitive with a complement frame that allows the found object and present state to work together; broader emotional branches remain secondary pressure.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun leaving the object range open as whatever they did
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) leaves the object range open: whatever they did. The relative pronoun lets past actions become findable objects without narrowing them to a named class, matching the book-totality already established.

topics.headline: open relative range of deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause avoids a list because the whole range of acted things is already in view.
topics.reason: The word functions as a relative pronoun and object domain for the finding and doing clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural doing/working verb for completed deeds that return as present evidence
words.root_gloss_range: root range of doing, working, purposeful action, and produced deeds; local perfect selects completed accountable action
words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) identifies the found material as what they worked or did. The perfect places the actions in completed worldly time, while the root’s work-field keeps accountability attached to deliberate production; same-surah deed-testing motifs culminate here in deeds made present.

topics.headline: worked actions as accountable products
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what returns is not vague guilt but the product of deliberate action.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by the relative object and refers to completed actions; broader work/product pressure supports moral accountability without overtranslating the verb.

words.gloss_range: accusative active participle marking the deeds as present, whether read as state or second complement after finding
words.root_gloss_range: root range of presence, attendance, and being on hand; local participle selects presentness while attendance imagery makes deeds feel like witnesses
words.prose: {{ar:حَاضِرًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥāḍiran}}) gives the finding clause its result: the deeds are present. Whether read as circumstantial state or second complement, the accusative makes presence the point, and the attendance sense lets the deeds feel like witnesses before the final no-wronging axiom.

topics.headline: deeds present as confronted attendees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the deeds not only remembered but standing present before the criminals.
topics.reason: Local valency permits ḥāl or second-object analysis, both yielding presentness; settlement/civilization branches are not selected beyond image-pressure.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction linking the narrated discovery to the independent no-wronging declaration
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes from narrated discovery into the final negated axiom. Because the following negation scopes over the imperfect verb rather than the discovery narrative, the finding of deeds remains affirmed evidence while the justice declaration stands as a general principle beyond the criminals’ case.

topics.headline: resumption into the justice axiom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final justice statement as the conclusion drawn from the record scene.
topics.reason: The particle opens an independent negated verbal clause after the finding scene and connects it as a conclusion.

words.gloss_range: negative particle before the imperfect verb, giving the no-wronging clause categorical ongoing force
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the following imperfect verb and makes the closing claim categorical: your Lord does not wrong. With the indefinite object at the end, the negation reaches anyone at all.

topics.headline: absolute negation of wronging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is not only about this case but about an ongoing divine attribute.
topics.reason: The lā plus imperfect construction supports habitual/categorical negation, and its scope extends to the indefinite object.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect verb denying that the Lord wrongs anyone, after the record has placed, counted, and presented deeds
words.root_gloss_range: root range of wronging, darkness, displacement, and diminution; local verb selects injustice while those layers sharpen what is denied
words.prose: {{ar:يَظْلِمُ}} ({{tr:yaẓlimu}}) is active and tied to the explicit Lord-subject, unlike the passive opening. After placement, counting, and present deeds, the wronging root’s displacement and diminution pressure makes the denial precise: justice does not misplace, darken, or reduce what is due; the contrast with 42:22 separates human wrongdoing from divine justice.

topics.headline: active denial of displacement and diminishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no deed or person is darkened, diminished, or put out of place after the exhaustive record.
topics.reason: The local verb denies divine wronging; broader darkness/displacement/diminution senses survive as semantic layers of what the denial excludes.

words.gloss_range: noun with second-person suffix, naming the Lord as subject of the final no-wronging clause
words.root_gloss_range: root range of lordship, mastery, ownership, nurturing, and governance; local construct selects your Lord as just subject of the axiom
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}) names the subject of the final denial and reattaches the axiom to the addressed listener through the second-person suffix. The Lord-title carries rightful governance, so no-wronging becomes an attribute of the ruler before whom the record scene unfolds, continuing the authority frame from 18:48.

topics.headline: Lord-subject reanchors the addressed listener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agent withheld at the opening now named as the Lord who does not wrong anyone.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative subject of the negated verb, and the suffix shifts address back from the criminals’ plural lament to the listener.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular object under negation, extending the no-wronging axiom to any individual at all
words.root_gloss_range: root range of one, single, unique, and individual; local indefinite under negation distributes the justice claim across every person
words.prose: {{ar:أَحَدًۭا}} ({{tr:aḥadan}}) closes the ayah by placing the singular indefinite under negation: not anyone at all. The final word moves from the inanimate record back to persons, and its echo with 18:47 joins two guarantees: no person left out of gathering and no person wronged in judgment.

topics.headline: anyone-at-all closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah closing on the irreducible individual after traversing book, criminals, deeds, and Lord.
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite under negation yields universal negative-polarity force while the singular form preserves individual distribution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The placed book, its failure to leave any small or large item, its enumeration, and the denial of wrong.
baseline_models.mechanism: Placement makes the book an operative object; the book-root joins dispersed items and fixes a judgment, while negated leaving and exhaustive enumeration close omission. The final denial of wrong constrains totalization to correct placement rather than overreach.

activation_trace.role: Setting a thing in its assigned place supplies the record's operative placement.
Joining item to item supplies aggregation of dispersed deeds into one record.
Binding proof, decree, or judgment makes the assembled record adjudicative rather than merely descriptive.
Leaving something behind supplies the omission operation explicitly negated of the book.
Enumeration with exhaustive pursuit closes the record across every scale of item.
Putting a thing in the wrong place supplies the placement error denied by the closing clause.

changed_reading.before: A written list happens to contain every deed.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately placed evidentiary object joins dispersed acts, makes them judgment-bearing, and closes both omission and misplacement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: You see the criminals apprehensive, and they find what they intentionally did present.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah moves from visible offenders and apprehension to finding their own intentional acts near and present. The book therefore does not only report an absent past; it mediates an encounter in which the deeds themselves function as present evidence.

activation_trace.role: Sight by eye or insight supplies the opening mode of evidentiary recognition.
Offense and culpability identify the viewers as implicated subjects of the evidence.
Fear mixed with vigilant concern supplies recognition before the verbal complaint.
Actually encountering or hitting upon the thing turns record-reading into discovery.
Intentional action makes the encountered material their own purposive doing.
Presence, witnessing, and proximity collapse the distance between past action and present accounting.

changed_reading.before: The offenders read reports about past deeds.
changed_reading.after: They encounter their own intentional deeds as proximate evidence, so the record re-presents rather than merely describes the past.

context_deltas.mechanism: The movement from flourishing mixture to dry fragments blown apart, then to abiding deeds and gathered people, re-reads the focus book's joining and counting as counter-dispersal. Transient matter loses coherence, but accountable acts and agents are retained and recollected.

activation_trace.role: Dry, broken vegetation supplies the material disintegration that threatens continuity.
Wind-winnowing and scattering supply dispersal that normally defeats retention.
Continuance and remaining supply the contrast class of deeds that endure.
Driving and gathering a group to one destination supplies recollection of dispersed agents.
The focus book's joining operation reassembles deed-items into one accountable whole.
Exhaustive counting prevents scattered fragments from dropping out of recollection.

structural_cues: 18:45 moves from mixture and growth to broken matter scattered by wind, and 18:46 immediately names what remains.
18:47 gathers the people before 18:49 gathers and counts their deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersal, remaining deeds, gathering, and exhaustive counting; I infer that the book functions as counter-dispersal memory. A live alternative is a simple contrast between transient worldly life and lasting reward without a record mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The book preserves information about deeds.
changed_reading.after: The book reverses the surrounding world's dispersal by recollecting agents and deed-fragments into an enduring accountable whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: People are first exposed for inspection and aligned in a row; the book is then placed, the offenders are seen, and their deeds are present. The spatial sequence turns the focus scene into a public audit in which subject, record, and evidence are mutually inspectable.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something out for inspection supplies public evidentiary exposure.
Alignment on a level line supplies ordered comparability among those presented.
The book's set placement positions the evidentiary object within the aligned scene.
Seeing makes the persons' response publicly inspectable rather than inward only.
Present and witnessed deeds complete the subject-record-evidence alignment.

structural_cues: The passive presentation of people in 18:48 is followed by the passive placement of the book in 18:49.
Row, placement, seeing, and presence form one spatially ordered sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, linear alignment, placement, sight, and presence; I infer an audit relation in which aligned persons can be matched to present deeds. A live alternative is that the row is ceremonial staging without a comparison function.

changed_reading.before: The book is displayed beside a crowd.
changed_reading.after: The crowd is first aligned for inspection, then the book and present deeds make each subject publicly auditable against the record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence denies successful substitution, witnessing, auxiliary help, reply, and continued partnership. This sharpens the focus phrase 'what they did': the present evidence remains attached to its actors and cannot be transferred to an ally, co-author, helper, or respondent.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in another's place supplies the condemned attempt at substitution.
Denied witnessed presence removes the alleged partners from evidentiary authorship.
Denied helperhood removes auxiliary agency that might share or deflect the account.
The partners' failed reply makes delegated defense unavailable.
A barrier between parties spatially seals the failure of partnership.
Their own intentional doing anchors the present evidence to the actors themselves.

structural_cues: 18:50 calls the chosen allies a bad substitute; 18:51 denies them witness and helper roles.
In 18:52 the called partners neither answer nor remain connected, while 18:49 says the actors find what they themselves did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed substitution, witness, help, response, and connection; I infer a non-transfer rule for agency in the focus record. A live alternative is that these verses reject false allegiance without specifying juridical transfer of responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The record identifies each person's deeds.
changed_reading.after: The record makes agency non-delegable: false allies cannot replace, co-author, support, answer for, or remain joined to the actor's present deeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated seeing and finding verbs carry recognition from the placed record to the approaching consequence. Seeing offenders and finding deeds present becomes seeing the fire, expecting its fixed arrival, and finding no turn away; the book is the first threshold in an irreversible encounter sequence.

activation_trace.role: The first act of sight opens recognition at the record.
The first finding makes their deeds an encountered reality.
Presence supplies the causal threshold between recorded past and arriving consequence.
Repeated sight carries recognition from the book to the fire.
Falling and becoming fixed supply the consequence's expected arrival.
Repeated finding, now of no escape route, closes the encounter.
Turning away is negated, making the recognition sequence irreversible.

structural_cues: The sequence mirrors 'you see the criminals' with 'the criminals saw' and 'they found their deeds' with 'they found no diversion.'
Apprehension at the book precedes certainty of encounter and absence of escape.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored verbs, present deeds, expected falling, and absent diversion; I infer that the record initiates a causal recognition cascade. A live alternative is simple narrative repetition without the book mediating the later encounter.

changed_reading.before: The complete book proves liability before a separate consequence.
changed_reading.after: The placed book begins the same unavoidable encounter that later reaches the fire: sight, finding, fixation, and no turn away form one cascade.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person can lose and abandon the memory of what his hands sent forward, but the book neither leaves it nor merely remembers it abstractly: the work is encountered as present. The focus record therefore externalizes moral memory against self-erasure.

activation_trace.role: Loss of recollection supplies the subject-side deletion that the record reverses.
Sending something ahead supplies temporal displacement of the deed from its actor.
What the hands acquired anchors the forgotten material in embodied agency.
Exhaustive enumeration preserves what subjective memory loses.
Encountering the thing reverses forgetting as an external discovery.
Presence returns the temporally advanced deed to the actor's immediate field.

structural_cues: Both ayat govern the deed with 'what': what the hands sent forward is forgotten, while what they did is found present.
Reminder, turning away, and forgetting in 18:57 oppose non-omission, enumeration, finding, and presence in 18:49.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgotten hand-deeds and exhaustive present work; I infer that the book is an external counter-memory. A live alternative is that presence serves only judicial proof and the forgetting contrast is moral rather than mnemonic.

changed_reading.before: The book recalls deeds that offenders may deny.
changed_reading.after: The book defeats self-erasure by returning forgotten, temporally displaced hand-deeds as an immediate encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The complete record does not mechanically produce immediate punishment. Forgiving protection and mercy coexist with an explicitly unrealized acceleration, while the appointment has both a fixed-time branch and a split mapped image of a counted waiting term. The focus denial of wrong can therefore govern timing as well as item-level accuracy.

activation_trace.role: Covering the offense and protecting its bearer from its effect supplies suspended consequence.
Merciful tenderness supplies a non-punitive relation alongside complete knowledge.
Explicitly unrealized acceleration separates evidentiary completeness from immediate execution.
An appointment fixed by time or place bounds when consequence arrives.
The split mapped image of a counted waiting term links appointed timing to the focus's exhaustive count.
Sustaining, repairing, and bringing to completion keep Lordship from collapsing into punitive surveillance.
Denial of wrong placement anchors the inference that consequence is not mistimed.

structural_cues: The unreal conditional says that taking people for what they acquired would have hastened punishment, then corrects to an appointed term.
The same Lord named after the exhaustive record is named forgiving and possessed of mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, non-acceleration, appointment, a counted-term branch, and denial of wrong; I infer that just accounting includes calibrated timing. A live alternative is that mercy only postpones an unchanged sentence and does not alter how 'no wrong' functions in 18:49.

changed_reading.before: Once the exhaustive record is present, punishment follows automatically and at once.
changed_reading.after: Complete evidence coexists with merciful suspension and a counted appointment, so precision governs both what is accounted and when consequence is allowed to arrive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from moral and textual senses into cutting and textile construction. It remains anchored in the focus roots for criminals, book, and placement, whose packet branches supply severing, joining, and cotton set into stitching. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, not as a lexical replacement for 'criminals' or 'book.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The criminals stand before a book that has been placed and that joins every item without omission.

activation_trace.role: Cutting and severing supply a contained material image for the offenders' fragmenting action.
Joining one thing to another supplies the answering operation that reunites separated deed-fragments.
Setting cotton into a sewn garment supplies the form-distant image of a record built by placing and stitching fragments.
Pebbles supply discrete material units that can be gathered, joined, and counted.

changed_reading.before: The book stores offenses committed by criminals.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the offenders' severing is answered by a record that places, stitches, and counts every separated fragment into an unbroken evidentiary fabric.

strongest_changes: The book became a counter-dispersal and counter-forgetting mechanism, not only a store of information.
Presentation in rows, placement, sight, and present deeds formed a public subject-record-evidence audit.
Mirrored seeing and finding made the book the first threshold of an irreversible encounter sequence.
Mercy, non-acceleration, and an appointed counted term prevented exhaustive recording from implying automatic immediate punishment.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest activations came from repeated roots and constructions across 18:47, 18:49, 18:53, 18:57, and 18:58, plus the split mapping of the appointment to both fixed promise-time and counted duration. Focus-only material branches also preserved a contained stitching-and-severance outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The anti-dispersal model may be a contextual contrast rather than a literal function of the record.
The non-transferable agency model may over-juridicize a broader collapse of false allegiance.
The counted-term use of the split appointment root and the stitched-severance model remain exploratory cross-branch activations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Intentional acts become found objects.** `ع م ل` B001 (“intentional doing and work”) is not merely reported; `و ج د` B001 (“finding and coming upon a thing”) makes the agents encounter their work present. This reverses the garden owner’s imagined finding of unearned good (18:36). I infer that action is preserved into an objective environment of encounter. The record does not manufacture guilt; it discloses what agency has made.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:103–105 revealed why present works can later be found yet possess no weight: orientation governs durability.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Counting converts past action into present encounter.** `ح ص ي/B002` is counting by number until the object is encompassed; its concrete `ح ص ي/B001` is pebbles. The double totalization `صَغِيرَة/كَبِيرَة` and `وَجَدُوا مَا عَمِلُوا حَاضِرًا` follows the no-one-left gathering and row of 18:47–48. identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamın merkezine kesip ayırmayı yerleştirir; hurma ürününü ağaçtan kesme, koyun yününü kırkma ve keserek alma kullanımları bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir. Köklü bir oluşuma ilişkin açıklama ise bağımsız bir temel anlam değil, kesilmiş bir toprak parçası tasarımına dayanan türetim yorumudur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kesme anlamı ile hurma hasadı, yün kırkma ve birinden keserek alma gibi belirli yapılara bağlı kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bütününden keserek ayırmak ve böylece ondan bir parça almaktır. Hurma ürününü ağaçtan kesip toplama ile koyun yününü kırkma bu işlemin özel uygulamalarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem bir tehlikeden çekinip sakınmayı hem de bir kişiyi kötülükten koruma isteğiyle kaygılı biçimde gözetmeyi açıkça içerir. Sağlanan dal kimliği korku ile ilginin bu yapı bağımlı dengesini doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, duygu ve nitelik bildiren yalın biçimleri korurken bir şeyden çekinme ile biri için kaygılanma yapılarını ayrı uzmanlaşmalar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Olası bir zararı düşünerek hem kaygı duymak hem de dikkatli davranmaktır. Tehlikeli görülen şeyden çekinmede korku, zarar görebilecek kişiyi gözetmede ise ilgi ve koruma isteği ağır basar.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, olası zarara yönelik korkuyla karışmış dikkatli ilgi ve sakınmadır.
Bir şeyden söz eden yapıda o şeyden korkma, çekinme ve ona karşı tedbirli olma öne çıkar.
Bir kişi için kullanılan yapıda, başına kötülük gelmesinden korkarak onu önemseme ve gözetme öne çıkar.
Kaygıyla gözeten kişi, karşısındakinin iyiliğini isteyen dikkatli ve istekli bir öğütçü olarak nitelenebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar korku, çekinme ve özenli ilgiyi ortak bir anlam alanında birleştirir; söz dizimine göre ya tehlikeden sakınma ya da zarar görebilecek kişiyi kaygıyla gözetme belirginleşir.

root_profile.summary: Kavram alanı, bir şeyi geride bırakma çekirdeğinin yanında söz yükümlülüğünü bozma, sel veya yağmurdan kalan su, sürüden geri kalan hayvan, geçilmesi güç arazi, sağlam duruş, saçın bırakılmış biçimleri ve karanlık gece anlamlarını içerir. Bu dallar bazı yerlerde bırakma imgesiyle bağlansa da tek bir çağdaş karşılık altında birleştirilemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, büyüklüğün karşıtı olan küçüklüğü beden, zaman veya yaş, ölçü ya da miktar ve konum boyutlarıyla birlikte verir; ayrıca bir şeyi küçültme ve küçük sayma işlemlerini de bu çekirdeğe bağlar. Bu kapsam, dalın genel küçüklük çerçevesiyle uyumludur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın küçüklük çekirdeği ile türemiş küçültme ve küçük sayma işlemleri ayrı tutulur; bitkisi kısa kalmış arazi kalıbı yalnız kendi yapısında geçerlidir ve genel tanıma taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlık veya niteliğin zaman ya da yaş, beden, ölçü veya miktar yahut konum bakımından büyük olmanın karşı ucunda bulunmasıdır. Buna bir şeyi küçültme veya onu küçük sayma işlemleri de bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Temel durum, büyüklüğün karşıtı olarak küçük olma veya azlık taşıma durumudur.
Küçüklük zaman veya yaşa, bedene, ölçü ya da miktara ve toplumsal ya da göreli konuma uygulanabilir.
Bir başkası bir şeyi küçük hale getirebilir veya daha aşağı bir konuma indirebilir.
Bir şey gerçekte değiştirilmeden küçük görülebilir veya küçük sayılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, küçüklüğü büyüklüğün karşıtı bir durum olarak kurar ve bu durumu yaş ya da zaman, beden, ölçü veya miktar ve konum alanlarına yayar. Küçültme ile küçük sayma da bu temel karşıtlıktan türeyen işlemlerdir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın küçük olma çekirdeğini ve bu çekirdeğe bağlı iki işlemi birlikte anlatan en kapsamlı kısa karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Küçük olma durumunu, küçültme işlemini ve bir şeyi küçük görme yargısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin yaş, beden, miktar, ölçü veya konum bakımından küçük olduğu durumlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Küçük olma çekirdeğini ve bunun farklı boyutlara uygulanabilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi küçültme veya küçük sayma işlemlerini tek başına belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin boyutu, miktarı veya konumu bir başkasınca daha küçük hale getirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi küçük hale getiren veya daha aşağı konuma indiren işlemi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin fiziksel olarak değiştirilmesinden değil, küçük olduğuna hükmedilmesinden söz edildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Değişiklik yapmadan bir şeyi küçük görme veya küçük kabul etme yargısını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Nötr fiziksel, zamansal, niceliksel ve konumsal küçüklük ile küçültme ve küçük sayma işlemleri bu dala özgüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal beden dışındaki yaş, miktar ve konum boyutlarını ve küçültme işlemlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iri, kalın, geniş ve sağlam yapılı bedeni özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Beden ölçüsü bakımından küçük ve büyük olma ortak bir karşıtlık ekseni kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Karşıtlık yalnız beden boyutunda nettir; bu dalın kapsamı daha genişken komşu dal iri ve kalın fiziksel yapıya özelleşir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi küçük taşların toplu adıyla tek bir taşı ve çoğul biçimini açıkça verir; ayrıca çakıllı arazi kullanımını ayrı bir yapıya bağlar. Bu çerçeve, nesne anlamıyla arazi niteliğini birbirine karıştırmadan dal kimliğini destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, küçük taşa ait yalın biçimleri çakıllı arazi bildiren kalıplaşmış yapıdan ayırır; arazi anlamı yalın sözcüğün bütün kullanımlarına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir arada düşünülen küçük taşları, bunlardan tek bir taşı ve çoğulunu anlatır. Ayrı bir yapıda ise bu küçük taşlarla kaplı araziyi niteler.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, küçük taşların topluluğudur.
Tek bir küçük taş ve bunun çoğul biçimi ayrıca adlandırılır.
Belirli bir arazi yapısı, üzerinde küçük taşlar bulunması bakımından nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar küçük taşlar topluluğu ile bunun tekil ve çoğul adlandırmalarında birleşir; ayrıca küçük taşlı araziyi bildiren bağımlı yapı kaydedilir.

concept_gloss.text: çakıl taşı, çakıllar ve çakıllı arazi

error_profile.preserves: Arazinin küçük taşlarla kaplı oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Küçük taşın kendisini ve taşlar topluluğunu adlandırmaz.

error_profile.adds: Küçük olmayan her türlü taşı da kapsayan daha geniş bir sınıf ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Küçük taşları ve bunlarla kaplı araziyi anlatır.
